document.title: Family Center local demo site content
document.purpose: Illustrative content seed for exploring a local nonprofit marketing hub and future Wagtail structure, with clear event/family and business-supporter paths.

lifecycle.deprecate_when: CEO-approved real organizational data has replaced the draft values in the deployed site and the owner has verified the live content.
lifecycle.archive_action: Record the replacement source and deployment/verification date; preserve the dated JSON snapshot rather than deleting it.

instructions: This file combines source-site snapshots, owner-reported planning context, draft copy, and invented event examples.
Every page has a stable key under pages; each event example is a separate page key and is explicitly marked demo-only.
Do not publish dates, venues, claims, contact details, images, or copy without the indicated owner review and confirmation.
The service lists on the old homepage and Our Services page conflict; this draft keeps current work and future aspirations distinct.
Keep private demographic planning context out of all external copy. Use organization-approved public language and do not invent impact, sponsorship benefits, or donation allocations.

visitor_paths.job: Find accurate event information and decide whether/how to attend.
Understand the work, evaluate ways to support it, and start a partnership conversation.

marketing_direction.fundraising_emphasis: Prioritize business giving and sponsorship conversations while keeping direct donation actions easy to find.
marketing_direction.event_page_campaign_rule: Send event ads to the matching canonical event page and make the ad-specific next action prominent. Avoid duplicate public pages for alternate avatar or campaign copy.
measurement_candidates: donation clicks or completions where measurable
marketing_direction.measurement_status: Agree on analytics, privacy, and conversion definitions before enabling tracking.

event_page_content_requirements: Confirmed date, start/end time, time zone, venue, and full address
Who the event is for and any eligibility or age/grade details
Cost, ticketing/registration, availability, and event-specific action
Schedule, what to expect, food, and what to bring when applicable
Accessibility, transportation, parking, and contact details when confirmed
For fundraisers, a clear explanation of the event's purpose and a separate sponsor/support action when applicable
